'''Bojo Boopa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] enforcer in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Boopa was tasked by his boss with getting the money out of moisture farmer [[Orrin Gault]], which was in debt to Jabba.
